topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: The shadows grow long in the house that was hers, now it is theirs, divided by blood but not by these walls. The creaks are familiar, yet foreign, as if the very boards remember her footsteps and mine, but not theirs. The air holds her scent, but it fades, lost to the newness they bring. They speak of change, of what to keep and what to let go. I move through rooms that whisper of the past, each step a question of what will remain when morning comes. The house watches, waits, as it has always done, but tonight it holds its breath.
